study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
cohort: 89 pregnant women with poorly controlled pregestational diabetes mellitus (HbA1c >6% at 3 months prior to conception or during the first trimester)
finding: While elevated periconceptional HbA1c levels were associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery in women with poorly controlled PGDM, a consistent association with other adverse outcomes was not observed.
